metanarrative_source: Canonical SLOP_METANARRATIV_R1.md reread from docs/kfb-decisions-register-2026-10-11; new biographies remain DESIGN, calls are proposals and not canonical Triplet excerpts

records.name: Flint Secondtry
records.biography_en: He sorts the building's contradictory cards into sharp and insufficiently sharp.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The Stone Age is waiting for his final polish.

records.name: Bram Bigidea
records.biography_en: He wants the Men in Black to patent a method of making uncertainty flatter.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Peer review is conducted with the same hammer.

records.name: Oona Hearthwise
records.biography_en: She keeps the HyperNorm hearth orderly, assigning troublesome ideas to the cold side of the bowl.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: She has domesticated fire. The household remains difficult.

records.name: Gus Mammothmaybe
records.biography_en: Hunky and Dory ask for confidence; Gus submits increasingly detailed footprints.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His evidence has begun following him home.

records.name: Pippa Ochremark
records.biography_en: She covers dissonant cards with handprints, then privately admires what shows through.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The first artist has already received a request for something more neutral.

records.name: Ned Provisions
records.biography_en: The Men in Black praise his neat categories: edible, inedible, and not yet authorized.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The third category has eaten most of the basket.
